payload.outcome: Resolved by commit 3b6e73c ("refactor(ui): UI, layout precision, design system, and developer hub optimization sweep", PR #2449, 2026-08-28); verified by direct grep against the working tree at 45a3dca on 2026-09-02, where `grep -nE "dvh|100vh|calc\(" src/components/mode-home-page-skeleton.tsx` returns no match at all. BOTH SITES THE ROW NAMED ARE CONVERTED TO FLEX GROWTH, which is the outcome the row's own "if yes" branch asked for rather than the recorded-exception fallback. Line 32, ModeHomeRouteLoading, was `sm:min-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--shell-header-h))]` and now reads `grid min-h-0 w-full flex-1 items-start justify-items-center bg-[color:var(--background)] pt-3 sm:items-center sm:pt-0`. Line 60, DocumentViewerPageSkeleton, was `h-[calc(100dvh-var(--shell-header-h))]` and now reads `flex min-h-0 flex-1 flex-col gap-4 px-4 py-4 animate-fade-in motion-reduce:animate-none`, with its body Skeleton carrying `min-h-0 flex-1` so the placeholder fills the grown box instead of a 4rem-short estimate. So the Suspense parent chain did turn out to carry a definite height, and the `--shell-header-h` estimate is gone from the file rather than documented as an exception. REINTRODUCTION IS NOW GUARDED REPO-WIDE, not per file. The two guards that existed when this row was written (tests/ui-overlay-css-contract.test.ts and tests/mobile-interaction-regressions.test.ts) are hard-coded allowlists of named files each asserting one literal string is absent, which is precisely why these two sites survived PR #2419 and needed a separate sweep a day later - and the second site was written `h-[calc(...)]` rather than `sm:min-h-[calc(...)]`, so even a repo-wide search for that one literal would have caught only half of it. tests/viewport-fill-contract.test.ts now scans every .ts, .tsx and .css file under src/ for any `(min-)h-[calc(100dvh - ...)]` class token or `(min-)height: calc(100dvh - ...)` declaration, deliberately excluding max-h/max-height as bounded-overlay sizing outside invariant 24's scope, skipping design scratch, and stripping comments so the invariant's own prose does not trip it. Its six legitimate phone-floor and specimen exemptions sit in one exact-count allowlist that fails the suite when an entry stops matching, so the list cannot rot silently. Proven by reintroducing both original class strings into the skeleton: the guard reported `src/components/mode-home-page-skeleton.tsx:32 sm:min-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--shell-header-h))]` and `src/components/mode-home-page-skeleton.tsx:60 h-[calc(100dvh-var(--shell-header-h))]`, and passed again once reverted. docs/search-chrome-behaviour.md invariant 24 now names that guard alongside tests/ui-chrome-scroll.spec.ts. NOT CLOSED BY THIS ROW: #6KR6BR, the separate 2px residual on /calculators/search, which is real page content rather than a chrome estimate and is untouched by either the fix or the new scan.
